DUAL 8K TRI-MODE CONNECTIVITY — Connect via lag-free 2.4GHz wireless, ultra-stable Bluetooth 5.4, or high-speed USB-C wired. Wired and 2.4GHz modes both support true 8000Hz polling for a 0.125ms polling interval, delivering fast, precise input for competitive gaming and everyday use.
CUSTOM UFO LINEAR SWITCHES & 5-LAYER GASKET MOUNT — GravaStar Custom UFO mechanical switches are factory pre-lubed for smooth, consistent keystrokes and rated for 70 million presses. The 5-layer dampened gasket structure combines Poron case foam, IXPE switch pad, PET film, and slow-rebound Poron to reduce unwanted resonance and create a deep, creamy "thock" sound straight out of the box.
19 ARGB EFFECTS & 4 AMBIENT SIDE-LIGHT MODES — Choose from 19 built-in ARGB backlight effects and 4 ambient side-light modes. Customize lighting directly through the web-based driver to match your gaming setup, workspace, or personal style.
1.65" TFT SMART DISPLAY & MULTIFUNCTION KNOB — The 142 × 428 TFT color display provides at-a-glance access to system information, keystroke data, and custom animations. The multifunction control knob provides convenient control for volume, scrolling, and other assigned functions without interrupting your workflow.
UP TO 228 HOURS OF WIRELESS USE — Enjoy up to 228 hours of use in 1K mode with RGB off, or up to 166 hours in 8K mode with RGB off. The web-based driver requires no software installation and lets you remap keys, program macros, and customize RGB settings. Compatible with Windows and macOS.
98-KEY COMPACT FULL LAYOUT WITH NKRO — The optimized 98% layout keeps a dedicated number pad and function row while using less desk space than a traditional full-size keyboard. Full N-key rollover and anti-ghosting help register simultaneous keystrokes accurately for gaming, coding, spreadsheets, and everyday productivity.
PREMIUM GLOSSY ALUMINUM ALLOY EXOSKELETON — Built with a premium glossy aluminum alloy exoskeleton measuring 18.11 × 6.69 × 2.46 inches and weighing 3.42 lbs with batteries. The Phantom Black finish adds a distinctive, futuristic look to gaming setups and professional workspaces.

DUAL 8K TRI-MODE CONNECTIVITY — Connect via lag-free 2.4GHz wireless, ultra-stable Bluetooth 5.4, or high-speed USB-C wired. Wired and 2.4GHz modes both support true 8000Hz polling for a 0.125ms polling interval, delivering fast, precise input for competitive gaming and everyday use.

UP TO 228 HOURS OF WIRELESS USE — Enjoy up to 228 hours of use in 1K mode with RGB off, or up to 166 hours in 8K mode with RGB off. The web-based driver requires no software installation and lets you remap keys, program macros, and customize RGB settings. Compatible with Windows and macOS.
98-KEY COMPACT FULL LAYOUT WITH NKRO — The optimized 98% layout keeps a dedicated number pad and function row while using less desk space than a traditional full-size keyboard. Full N-key rollover and anti-ghosting help register simultaneous keystrokes accurately for gaming, coding, spreadsheets, and everyday productivity.
PREMIUM GLOSSY ALUMINUM ALLOY EXOSKELETON — Built with a premium glossy aluminum alloy exoskeleton measuring 18.11 × 6.69 × 2.46 inches and weighing 3.42 lbs with batteries. The Phantom Black finish adds a distinctive, futuristic look to gaming setups and professional workspaces.
